screenshots.caption: The bucket is in the hotbar while the owned crafting menu remains open. This frame precedes final idle. The later integrated-server receipt verifies recovery before crafting, minimum health three, zero deaths, an empty cursor and stopped navigation. The fixture supplies three iron ingots, two cooked beef, water/bedrock geometry and one placed table.
Additional unedited owned-window capture after the bucket command completes, including the native Minecraft 1.21.1 title and HUD. This capture occurs after recovery; it does not show the swim itself.

Completed bucket command and HUD on the dry ledge. The integrated server verifies low-air recovery before crafting, minimum health three, zero deaths, an empty cursor and stopped navigation. The fixture supplies three iron ingots, two cooked beef, water/bedrock geometry and one placed table.
